name: Mustard Greens

low.description: About 1 cup chopped raw or 1/2 cup cooked

siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as a low FODMAP leafy green. Cook thoroughly if experiencing sensitivity to raw cruciferous vegetables.
preparationTips: Remove thick stems before cooking as they can be tough and fibrous
Sauté with garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for FODMAP-friendly flavor
Blanch briefly in boiling water to reduce bitterness if desired
Add to soups and stews in the last few minutes of cooking to preserve nutrients
